about: The SQL each runtime builds for a query (Clarity's find), per database. Every stack's runtime must give the same statement and parameters. A condition is one of: compare and number (column, op, value; number compares decimals and money as numbers), contains (column, text), oneOf and oneOfNumbers (column, values), isTrue (a column), isNone (a column with no value: an empty date or reference), through (a reference column, the table and key it refers to, and a condition on that table, which becomes a subquery), and, or (two conditions), not (one). An order key may go through references too, each hop a subquery on an alias t1, t2 and so on. A value is text, integer, decimal (as text), bool, date or null. The select list is the key and then the columns, each quoted.

cases.name: every record, in the order stored
a decimal is compared as a number

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" WHERE CAST("credit_limit" AS REAL) > CAST(?1 AS REAL) ORDER BY "id"

cases.name: contains ignores case and escapes wildcards

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" WHERE "name" LIKE ?1 ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" WHERE LOWER("name") LIKE LOWER($1) ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `customer` WHERE LOWER(`name`) LIKE LOWER(?) ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [name] FROM [customer] WHERE LOWER([name]) LIKE LOWER(@P1) ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY [id]

cases.name: SQL Server also escapes a bracket

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" WHERE "name" LIKE ?1 ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" WHERE LOWER("name") LIKE LOWER($1) ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `customer` WHERE LOWER(`name`) LIKE LOWER(?) ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [name] FROM [customer] WHERE LOWER([name]) LIKE LOWER(@P1) ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY [id]

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" WHERE "kind" IN (?1, ?2) ORDER BY "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" WHERE "kind" IN ($1, $2) ORDER BY "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `customer` WHERE `kind` IN (?, ?) ORDER BY `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [name] FROM [customer] WHERE [kind] IN (@P1, @P2) ORDER BY [id]

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "number" FROM "order" WHERE CAST("total" AS REAL) IN (CAST(?1 AS REAL), CAST(?2 AS REAL)) ORDER BY "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "number" FROM "order" WHERE "total" IN ($1, $2) ORDER BY "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `number` FROM `order` WHERE `total` IN (?, ?) ORDER BY `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [number] FROM [order] WHERE [total] IN (@P1, @P2) ORDER BY [id]

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" WHERE "active" = TRUE ORDER BY "id"

cases.name: an empty date, and a reference that is set

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "album" FROM "loan" WHERE ("returned_on" IS NULL AND NOT ("friend" IS NULL)) ORDER BY "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "album" FROM "loan" WHERE ("returned_on" IS NULL AND NOT ("friend" IS NULL)) ORDER BY "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `album` FROM `loan` WHERE (`returned_on` IS NULL AND NOT (`friend` IS NULL)) ORDER BY `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [album] FROM [loan] WHERE ([returned_on] IS NULL AND NOT ([friend] IS NULL)) ORDER BY [id]

cases.name: and, or and not nest in parentheses

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" WHERE (("name" = ?1 AND "active" = 1) OR NOT (CAST("credit_limit" AS REAL) <= CAST(?2 AS REAL))) ORDER BY "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" WHERE (("name" = $1 AND "active" = TRUE) OR NOT ("credit_limit" <= $2)) ORDER BY "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `customer` WHERE ((`name` = ? AND `active` = 1) OR NOT (`credit_limit` <= ?)) ORDER BY `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [name] FROM [customer] WHERE (([name] = @P1 AND [active] = 1) OR NOT ([credit_limit] <= @P2)) ORDER BY [id]

cases.name: dates, references and the other comparisons

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "number" FROM "order" WHERE ("ordered_on" >= ?1 AND ("customer" != ?2 AND "paid" < ?3)) ORDER BY "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "number" FROM "order" WHERE ("ordered_on" >= $1 AND ("customer" != $2 AND "paid" < $3)) ORDER BY "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `number` FROM `order` WHERE (`ordered_on` >= ? AND (`customer` != ? AND `paid` < ?)) ORDER BY `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [number] FROM [order] WHERE ([ordered_on] >= @P1 AND ([customer] != @P2 AND [paid] < @P3)) ORDER BY [id]

cases.name: an order, numbers sorted as numbers, the key last

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "customer" ORDER BY "name" DESC, CAST("credit_limit" AS REAL), "id"
SELECT "id", "title" FROM "album" WHERE "artist" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "artist" WHERE "name" LIKE ?1 ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "title" FROM "album" WHERE "artist" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "artist" WHERE LOWER("name") LIKE LOWER($1) ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `title` FROM `album` WHERE `artist` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `artist` WHERE LOWER(`name`) LIKE LOWER(?) ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [title] FROM [album] WHERE [artist] IN (SELECT [id] FROM [artist] WHERE LOWER([name]) LIKE LOWER(@P1) ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY [id]

cases.name: through two references, and a decimal on the far side

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "title" FROM "track" WHERE ("album" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "album" WHERE "artist" IN (SELECT "ArtistId" FROM "artist" WHERE "country" = ?1)) AND "album" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "album" WHERE CAST("price" AS REAL) > CAST(?2 AS REAL))) ORDER BY "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "title" FROM "track" WHERE ("album" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "album" WHERE "artist" IN (SELECT "ArtistId" FROM "artist" WHERE "country" = $1)) AND "album" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "album" WHERE "price" > $2)) ORDER BY "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `title` FROM `track` WHERE (`album` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `album` WHERE `artist` IN (SELECT `ArtistId` FROM `artist` WHERE `country` = ?)) AND `album` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `album` WHERE `price` > ?)) ORDER BY `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [title] FROM [track] WHERE ([album] IN (SELECT [id] FROM [album] WHERE [artist] IN (SELECT [ArtistId] FROM [artist] WHERE [country] = @P1)) AND [album] IN (SELECT [id] FROM [album] WHERE [price] > @P2)) ORDER BY [id]

cases.name: a reference to a record of the same table

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "genre" WHERE "parent" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "genre" WHERE "name" = ?1) ORDER BY "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "name" FROM "genre" WHERE "parent" IN (SELECT "id" FROM "genre" WHERE "name" = $1) ORDER BY "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `genre` WHERE `parent` IN (SELECT `id` FROM `genre` WHERE `name` = ?) ORDER BY `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [name] FROM [genre] WHERE [parent] IN (SELECT [id] FROM [genre] WHERE [name] = @P1) ORDER BY [id]

cases.name: an order through references, each in its own subquery

sqlite.sql: SELECT "id", "title" FROM "track" ORDER BY (SELECT "t1"."title" FROM "album" "t1" WHERE "t1"."id" = "track"."album"), (SELECT (SELECT "t2"."name" FROM "artist" "t2" WHERE "t2"."ArtistId" = "t1"."artist") FROM "album" "t1" WHERE "t1"."id" = "track"."album") DESC, (SELECT CAST("t1"."price" AS REAL) FROM "album" "t1" WHERE "t1"."id" = "track"."album"), "id"

postgres.sql: SELECT "id", "title" FROM "track" ORDER BY (SELECT "t1"."title" FROM "album" "t1" WHERE "t1"."id" = "track"."album"), (SELECT (SELECT "t2"."name" FROM "artist" "t2" WHERE "t2"."ArtistId" = "t1"."artist") FROM "album" "t1" WHERE "t1"."id" = "track"."album") DESC, (SELECT "t1"."price" FROM "album" "t1" WHERE "t1"."id" = "track"."album"), "id"

mysql.sql: SELECT `id`, `title` FROM `track` ORDER BY (SELECT `t1`.`title` FROM `album` `t1` WHERE `t1`.`id` = `track`.`album`), (SELECT (SELECT `t2`.`name` FROM `artist` `t2` WHERE `t2`.`ArtistId` = `t1`.`artist`) FROM `album` `t1` WHERE `t1`.`id` = `track`.`album`) DESC, (SELECT `t1`.`price` FROM `album` `t1` WHERE `t1`.`id` = `track`.`album`), `id`

mssql.sql: SELECT [id], [title] FROM [track] ORDER BY (SELECT [t1].[title] FROM [album] [t1] WHERE [t1].[id] = [track].[album]), (SELECT (SELECT [t2].[name] FROM [artist] [t2] WHERE [t2].[ArtistId] = [t1].[artist]) FROM [album] [t1] WHERE [t1].[id] = [track].[album]) DESC, (SELECT [t1].[price] FROM [album] [t1] WHERE [t1].[id] = [track].[album]), [id]
